instruction: You are given an incomplete OpenFOAM case in `/home/user/Desktop/cavity_base/`. Complete a 2D incompressible laminar channel-flow analysis from the command line: 1. Modify and create case `/home/user/Desktop/channel/`: - Change the geometry to a rectangular channel (aspect ratio >= 10), and set boundary conditions suitable for fully developed laminar flow - Set incompressible laminar fluid properties - Configure solver settings to convergence 2. Run the solver and ensure the flow is fully developed. 3. Extract the outlet velocity profile and verify it against Poiseuille-flow theory. 4. Write a post-processing script to output `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt`: - Outlet maximum velocity `u_max` - Format: `u_max` 5. Do not use the ParaView GUI.
